Her left leg wears a pastel pink chunky ribbed knit leg warmer slouched in soft folds around her left calf from just above the ankle to just below the knee, her left knee, thigh and the top of her foot bare, the warmer resting above her heel. Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, heavy gold rings on every finger, and large drop earrings, a polished silver chain ending in a heavy gold bell on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.

ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
